title: Voc Eval in Barnett Hall, Two Weeks of Butt-Heads, & The Hall Pass Prison
description: Arriving at Barnett Hall on a Sunday in March 2007, twenty-one-year-old Katie and Nate endure a creepy first roommate, nasty cafeteria rations, and a two-week Vocational Evaluation where they have to prove they know how to make a bed and do laundry, butt heads with evaluators who demand they split up to 'prove social skills,' and despise begging for Hall Passes just to ride the VATS bus or visit ValueMart.
